strings.en: Stay right there!
Bring it on! I love a good fight!
All right, let's settle this!
I hate a hassle, but... no choice!
I'll take you on!
First strike's mine!
In a fight, first strike wins!
I'm not holding back!
Hit 'em fast!
Here I come!
Ain't got time to waste!
I'm gonna slap that face of yours silly!
Ain't got time to fool around!
Whoever swings first wins!
Don't let your guard down, Kota.
I know!
Kota, focus your mind on the crystal.
Right!
Kota, learn from the mistakes/　of our last battle.
Like I remember that stuff now!
Here it comes, Kota!
All right, let's go!
Don't misjudge how you spend your power, Kota.
Yeah, I'm goin' all out!
Be Cautious, Kota.
Don't sweat the small stuff!
Kota, don't rush.
I got a short fuse, see!
An Emperor Unit? Bring it on!/　This here's the Compati Kaiser!
Gu-Landon!/　Best you'll ever be is an emperor with no clothes!
Gomou, Gobou, whatever you are,/　I'll make you regret showin' up!
Reggiane! Showin' up now ain't gonna/　be enough to stop us!
Know your place, Herluga!
Kota, we mustn't let him have the Cross Gate.
Yeah, I'll shove him right outta the ring!
Jellyfish oughta stay down in the sea!
Think you can beat the Compati Kaiser in strength?!
Bigger means more to pound on!
Combine or split up, I'm takin' you down!
Whatever you really are, I only got one thing to do!
I've beaten gods and devils before, pal!
Go pick a fight with Dark Brain in the next world!
XN-L! This is your last fight!
Hang in there, big bro!
Yeah, leave it to me!
Here they come, bro!
Alright... let's go, Shoko!
Let's hit 'em, Shoko!
Yeah!
The G Compati Kaiser'll take you on!
All right, let's get this started!
Got it, big brother!
At this range... I can do it!
Right!
That's a bull's-eye!
Big brother, are you aiming properly?!
An Emperor Unit? Bring it on!/　This here's the G Compati Kaiser!
The Emperor Unit is stronger than expected.
Then we'll go one better!
Simple, but you're right!
Lemme teach ya: money comes and goes!
Don't think money and time last forever!
If you wanna see red so bad,/　I'll show you our household books!
Hey! What are you saying?!
Wearin' a halo like that! What are you, a Buddha?!
You said that before, too.
Th-That thing... it's way too big!
Heh, no need to aim carefully.
No. Aim properly.
No way, they combined...!
Hey, so can we! Let's go!
Don't go actin' big just 'cause you combined!
Of course they're big, they got bigger!
Destroying you... is my mission!
I will destroy XN-L with my entire being...!
Like heck! You mean us!
That's right, we're all in this together!
I'll catch you and ship you off/　to an art museum!
Don't you mean a history museum?
Let's go, Akimi!
Mock battle or not, I ain't holdin' back!
Don't expect me to go easy on ya!
I'll beat that rotten attitude outta you!
However many times you come, I'll knock you flat!
So-Des, get ready!
Don't think things'll go your way!
I'll rough you up, just short of breakin' you!
I'll break that big nose of yours!
You never learn, do ya, Jua-Mu!
Don't get cocky, Jua-Mu!
Hmph, what a crude bastard!
He's really cut loose, that guy...!
Al-Van, Al-Bun, whatever!/　No cheap tricks!
I know full well that guy's tough!
Stab me if you think you can!
Fu-Ruu, I ain't holdin' back!
So you're gonna defy the Princess, huh?!
Whatever you're plottin', it ends here!
Karo-Ran!/　Looks like your machine ain't the only black thing!
Sneakin' around, you Balmar lackey!
What are you guys plottin'?!
Comin' to Earth ain't gonna do you any good!
Tuck your tail and get outta here!
Gadisword, you want a fight, you got one!
You guys started this!
I ain't got time to deal with you guys!
Get outta my way, I said!
Struttin' around with that fancy scythe!
Vort! I'll be your opponent!
Guess we gotta settle this, Vort!
Wipe that grin off your face, ya big Buddha!
Kota, don't be fooled by his appearance.
Yeah! He ain't a clown, he's a big Buddha, right?!
Fatso! I ain't handin' the Lamaris over to you!
I got no interest in your street act!
I'm gonna smack that big face of yours!
I'll make that pyramid your gravestone!
Fatso! Today's the last time I see your face!
That bastard was still alive?!
Fatso! This time I'm gonna/　send you off for good!
I'll flatten ya and stand ya next to the Kannon!
Putting that there would be quite a nuisance.
Like I'd let that amoeba creep have his way!
I'm peelin' that amoeba creep off!
I bet the Zovorg guys are panickin' too!
I'll take you down, amoeba creep and all!
If nobody's aboard, I won't hold back!
Gotta smash it, amoeba creep and all!
Controllin' stuff like that won't get you nowhere!
Think a Yokijin's gonna make any difference?!
Here I come, ya candied-chestnut creep!
Candied-chestnut creep, I'll smash you to bits!
Dunno which one's your real face,/　so I'll slap 'em both!
Dark Brain's leftovers showin' up now, of all times!
I'll rough you up and get some answers outta you!
Candied-chestnut creep!/　Today's the last time I see your face!
Dark Brain's waitin' for you in the next world!
I'll smash you to dust, not just bits, Skully!
Skully, don't think you'll get off with broken bones!
I'll crack your schemes and your bones to pieces!
Why's that skeleton creep talkin' in a Kansai accent?!
Like a bunch of Lamaris could beat us!
I'm sick of seein' your faces!
Attackin' us over and over.../　Gimme a break already!
Geez, you guys never learn!
Geez, these space aliens never learn.
Quit messing with Earth!
I ain't lettin' you lay another finger on Earth!
I got no business with small fry! Beat it!
Usin' other folks' planet for your own ends!
Sunrise or whatever, just get lost already!
Come five times? Don't ever come back!
I ain't lettin' you lay a finger on them!
Over here! I'll be your opponent!
I don't mind a big brute!
Heh, this one's worth poundin' on!
A battle of power? That's my home turf!
Nobody beats me in a power contest!
Heh, this guy's worth punchin'!
I'll squash that ship flat/　and sink it in the Sumida River!
Bring out a new model, it's still gonna end the same!
If you're evil aliens, I ain't showin' mercy!
Luggin' around a big tube on your back!
You're just a grunt anyway!
I'll work out those stiff shoulders for ya!
Heh, this guy's all lopsided!
Stay right there, big shoulders!
I'll scatter you, Fury!
I'll snap that horn right off!
Hmph, this guy sure stands out!
Here I come, thorn creep!
Hmph, the Compati Kaiser's way pointier!
Guess all I can do now is run!
Here I come, scarecrow creep!
Scarecrows oughta stand in rice paddies!
Wavin' those pincers around! What are you, a crab?!
I'll cut those pincers off!
You ain't touchin' Akimi and the others, you bastard!
I'm sick of these fake yokai!
Here I come, yokai creep!
Monster, get ready!
Makin' a goofy face like that!
You're like a ghost! Hurry up and rest in peace!
What are you guys, cockroaches?!
Lamaris, go rest in peace already!
I'll make short work of these Lamaris!
I'll wipe you out without a trace, big Lamaris!
Like I'd lose to somethin' Fatso left behind!
Damn that Fatso, spawnin' somethin' like that!
Kaana or Ida, I'll send every/　last one of you to rest!
I'll wipe you all out right here!
So you literally came back to haunt us, huh?!
Fine, then I'll grab that bastard by the scruff!
Like I'd let Dark Brain come back!
Now it's my turn!
You're not getting away!
I ain't letting you leave in one piece!
This fight ain't over yet!
Let's start over!
Time to settle this!
You want a fight, you got one!
Where d'ya think you're goin'?!
Like I'd keep quiet after you took a swing at me!
Damn, is this it?!
Dammit! Not here!
I'm not backing down now!/　Time to turn this around!!
Whatever kind of fight it is,/　I've got no plans to lose!
Waagh! Wh-What a guy!!
Th-This could be trouble...!
What the heck was that... Blew my mind.
Waaaagh!!
Ngh...!/　If only I could take the hit for you...
Ugh! That one stings!
Believe... in the Kaiser,/　and in yourself...!
Kota, the B-Frame in the left knee is damaged.
Cut right to the bone, huh? That's deep...!
Th-This is one great battle...!
Th-That ain't a street act... It's a magic trick!
No, it's sorcery.
Kyaaah!!
Damn! You'll pay for hurting Shoko!!
Cute trick! Do it again!
Wh-What are you saying, big brother?!
Ngh! This is a real jam!
Don't give up, big brother!
Lose to a knight?! I'm a true son of Edo!
Th-That's got nothing to do with it!
Where the heck did that bastard/　learn a trick like that...?!
N-Not in Asakusa, that's for sure...!
Damn you, So-Des, you shameless creep!
So this is Jua-Mu's pride!
Not bad, Al-Van!!
You're sloppy at the finish, Karo-Ran!
Think that's gonna make me despair?!
Don't get full of yourself, Iradoya!
I'm definitely smackin' that smug face of yours!
Ngh! I ain't backin' down, Vort!
M-My blood's as hot as/　an Edo bathhouse...!
Act your age, old-timer!
Leave that amoeba creep alone and it's trouble!
Tch, the possession's made it stronger!
Top of their army ain't a lie, huh...!
That Skully,/　he went and hit me with everything...!
L-Like I'd accept/　the answer you came up with!
That is no longer/　the Grandred Fenossa...!
Yeah, we gotta bring it to justice ourselves...!
The Soul Saber's performance is quite something.
Yeah, Akimi and the others ain't bad either.
I-I'm gonna squash you flat later, for sure!
Damn, so it's got the power of dozens of Lamaris?!
You bastard, that hurt!
Ngh... That was a good one.
Not yet!/　A fight ain't over till it's over!
Don't think that'll stop me!
Not bad...! But!!
Ugh, I screwed up!
Damn, that was embarrassin'...!
Damn, I screwed up!
Learn from your mistakes, Kota.
You got me, you son of a...!!
Calm down, Kota./　Assess the situation coolly.
Ow, ow.../　Grandpa's gonna chew me out for this.
...As usual.
Kota, are you all right?
This?/　It's nothing next to Grandpa's fists!
Did I dodge the wrong way?!
No, they were one step ahead.
What was that move?! Play it back!
We can't afford to watch that.
Roa, you're slow!
The AM Sheaves on the left hip appear torn.
Why you! Even with that goofy face!
Damn, his moves threw me off!
That bastard and his weird moves!
Damn that candied-chestnut creep, mockin' me!
Knock it off already, XN-L!
Fight on, big brother!!
Yeah! Just watch, Shoko!
That last one made Shoko mad!
...I kinda feel sorry for 'em.
We got hit! You okay?!
Yeah, don't worry about Shoko!
Shoko! Bring me a charm from Senso-ji!
Huh? Why?
To ward off evil!
Damn it, I'm never eatin' candied chestnuts again!
That's got nothing to do with the Crystal Dragoon!
Ngh, that XN-L bastard!
Even if its power has grown...!
Shoko and the others will never lose!
Oh... Akimi's pretty good!
Now you've made me mad, So-Des!
Didn't even faze me, Jua-Mu!
You'll pay for that, Al-Van!
Damn, Fu-Ruu, you're fast!
Damn Karo-Ran, he's used to fightin'...!
Lose to a fake emperor, and the Kaiser name'll cry!
Tch! Iradoya's sure got me irritated!
Damn, something's really/　throwing me off...!
Throwin' money at it only gets you this far, huh!
Ngh! You rammed me good, Vort!
Stay outta my way, Reggiane!
Herluga, how long are you/　gonna lounge around up there?!
Tch! I ain't payin' a dime for your act!
Fatso's gonna laugh at me.../　Nah, that guy's always laughin'.
Guess he don't have four legs just for show...!
Ngh! That one hit me right to the bone!
D-Damn it! A puppet did this much...!
They can read every move we make?!
Hmph, warm-up's over!
That hurt, thorn creep!
Scrawny thing's got a lotta power!
Damn, gettin' hit by a scarecrow!
Tch! Throws punches but no kicks, huh?!
Tch, it ain't just the looks... Its attacks are brutal!
Tch, that stung... Like a jellyfish.
Damn, this floaty, wobbly thing!
Ngh! I ain't the one who's gonna rest in peace!
Tch, come back for payback, huh?
Damn aliens...! I ain't goin' down yet!
Are those guys gettin' a little stronger...?!
No, you've simply forgotten.
Ngh, can't believe I got hit!
This? It doesn't even count as a scratch!
Like I'd flinch at something like this!
What, that's it? No big deal.
What a lousy attack!
Don't worry about it, I'm fine!
Heh, I'm just gettin' warmed up!
Don't falter, Kota.
Yeah, this is nothing!
This much... The Kaiser can take it.
Yeah, I'll have to thank Gramps!
Kota, let that be a lesson to you.
I already forgot it!
I'm the one who's gonna be laughin', Fatso!
That candied-chestnut creep's fast for his size!
XN-L!/　There ain't nothin' you can destroy!
Big brother, are you okay?!
Are you hurt?!
Nope, Shoko's fine!
That's a piece of cape to the Compati Kaiser!
...Don't you mean cake?
Shoko's thunder hits way harder than that!
What's that supposed to mean?!
Big Buddha that he is,/　he's actin' like a clown...!
That thing's neither, you know.
Candied-chestnut creep that he is,/　he's actin' like a dragon!
Any way you look at it, that's a dragon.
Don't underestimate Shoko and the others!
I will not let the lives of this world be snuffed out.
Just you watch, XN-L!
What's wrong? Don't hold back, Akimi!
Everything about you's shallow, So-Des!
I got no intention/　of entertainin' you!
That don't work on me, Jua-Mu!
I lost track of Al-Van's movements...!
Is that all a Fury knight's got?!
Karo-Ran.../　You're nicer than you look, huh?
That ain't an emperor, that's a kid's scuffle!
Gaah! That woman's gettin' on my nerves!
Turns out you like wastin' effort, Gomoudokka!
Tch, first I gotta do somethin' about that scythe!
Blood this, blood that! What are you, a vampire?!
Usin' the Cross Gate's power/　and gettin' all cocky...!
Just bones, so that's all you got, huh?
Tch, and I've fought this guy so many times!
You'll pay for that, alien!
For toughness, I won't lose to your machine!
Not with what you're controllin'!
That's it, come at me!
Hmph, a thorn got stuck in me!
A thorn's sting ain't nothin' much.
I ain't into playin' with ghosts!
Maybe I oughta get myself exorcised.
Bring it on, monster!
That bastard, throwin' confusin' attacks!
What is that yokai creep?!
Combined or not, it ain't nothin' special.
Hmph... Just a patchwork creep after all.
Stronger than a Kaana. Not that that's a surprise.
I caught that one, Ares Geist!
Too slow!
Where're you looking?!
I'm over here!
Heh, what a slowpoke.
Get hit? No way!
I can dodge that easy!
A miss, a big ol' miss!
Quick reaction, big brother!
Instinct?
...My hand just slipped.
Like that'll hit me!
B-big brother...!/　Pilot a little more carefully!
S-sorry...
Go do your street act in front of Kaminarimon!
You can't say that!
An act like that ain't gonna draw a crowd!
That ain't gonna be a fight, Akimi!
You got no Spirit and no Vigor, So-Des!
You think that's gonna beat us, Jua-Mu?!
Where are you lookin', Al-Van?!
What, all that big talk and that's it, Karo-Ran?!
Take down that Emperor Unit sign already!
Come back when you're ready, Vort!
You ain't hittin' me, Reggiane!
Can't you handle the Cross Gate?!
I know all your tricks!
Four eyes, and that's the best you can do?!
What's wrong?! You oughta know/　the Compati Kaiser real well!
Too bad, XN-L!
Kota, don't underestimate a Kashin warship's power.
Like I'd lose to some puppet!
Like I'd lose to Zovorg small fry!
Like I'd let some aliens beat me!
Heh, you really are small fry.
Even with that, you ain't no match for us!
Fine, I'll be your opponent!
Over here, catch me if you can!
Firin' wild like that won't do you any good!
Too slow, tube creep!
Those shoulders are too heavy for ya, huh!
Serves you right, thorn creep!
Your thorns can't pierce me!
Don't think you can pinch me!
Don't think you can possess me!
Lamaris ain't nothin' to me!
Hurry up and go to the next world!
Combinin' made 'em slower.
However many of you bunch up, you can't beat me!
Hmph, what a creepy bastard.
Its power might be up,/　but its eyes ain't so good!
Like I'd lose to some monster!
Go on, get lost!
I'm used to a good brawl!
Like I'd let you catch me that easy!
Heh, like that'd hit!
Don't get cocky, Kota./　The battle's not over yet.
All right, dodged it!
React 0.2 seconds later,/　and that would have hit.
Always with the half-baked advice...
See that, Roa?!
...I can hardly look away.
You've grown, Kota.
Huh? I ain't gotten any taller.
That move... I have nothing in particular to say.
Is that supposed to be praise?
I'm counting on you, big brother!
See that, Shoko?!
Yeah. But... that was close.
Dodged that on a hunch!
Big brother... Watch the enemy's movements properly.
Big as it is, it sure throws some crazy attacks.
Skully swung and missed!
You watched the Skull Knight's movements well.
I just dodged that on instinct.
Whew, close one. Coulda been split in two.
As if that'd work!
Can't take everything you dish out!
Useless, useless!
Damn, I can't counter!
I ain't got time to sit/　around takin' a break here!
Tch, what's goin' on?!
Where'd that one go?!
Ngh, I lost sight of 'em!
Tch, slippery one, ain't ya...
I can still keep going!
I ain't missin' this chance!
I'll lend you a hand!
No reason not to attack here!
I'll crash into 'em too!
Arado, I'll take it from here!
Seolla, leave this to me!
Latune, I'll give you a hand!
Raul! I'll handle the rest!
Go on ahead, Boss!
Shoko, leave the rest to me!
Shoko, don't do anything too reckless!
Ing, leave the rest to me!
I'll help, Josh!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Touma, I've got your back!
Masaki, leave the rest to me!
Michiru! You owe me one for this!
Michiru! I told ya, leave that one to me!
Touya, let me take over!
I'll lend you a hand, Touya!
I'm followin' the Bellzelute!
I'm up next, Akimi!
After the Saber comes the Kaiser!
Leave it all to me, Akemi!
Nice job, Akemi! Leave the rest to me!
Yon, I'll help ya!
You had real Spirit there, Sieg!
Leave the rest to me, Sally!
Flashy as ever, Haken!
Never thought I'd end up lendin' that guy a hand!
Charge! Compati Kaiser!
Not on my watch!
I'll handle this one!
Like I'd stay quiet with a buddy in a pinch!
Duty and compassion are the pride of Edo!
Arado, what're you doin'?!
Fall back, Seolla!
Latune, get outta here!
Raul, run while you can!
Boss, leave this to me!
Keep your hands off Shoko!!
Nobody lays a hand on my sister!
Shoko, get out of here, now!
I'll protect Shoko!!
Fall back, Ing!
Josh, leave this to me!
Rim, don't do anything crazy!
Touma, I've got this!
Michiru! What the hell are you doing?
Fine, whatever! I'll bail you out, Michiru!
Look out, Touya!
Touya! Your life ain't yours alone!
I ain't lettin' them get the Bellzelute!
Akimi, leave this to me!
Akemi, get out of here, now!
Haken, I'm repayin' that debt from before!
Can't be helped! I'll cover ya, Skully!
If even Cybuster can't dodge it, then...!
I'll take you all on at once!!
Raaagh! Get outta my way!!
Take this too, dammit!
This'll finish it!
A true son of Edo never hoards his cash!
So you're not holding anything back.
You can still do it, big brother!
Yeah, I'll push right through!
Over! Beeeeeam!!
Take this! Over Beam!!
Now, use the Spiral Knuckle!
Spiral! Knuuuckle!!
Unleash Kaiser's fist!
Raaagh! Spiral Knuuuckle!!
Raaagh!
Go! Spiral Knuckle!!
Kaiser Boooomerang!!
Slice 'em up! Kaiser Boomerang!!
Roar! Kaiser Boomerang!!
Kota, Kaiser Burst!
Kaiserrr... Burst!!
Take this! My finishing move!!
Kaiser Buuurst!!
Double Spiral Knuckle!!
Kaiser Burst!!
Not yet!!
Kaiserrr! Tornaaaaado!!
This ends now!!
Kaiser Tornado!!/　Blast right throughhh!!
Now! Shoulder Cannon!!
Shoulder Cannon! Fire!!
Fire Kaiser's twin fists!
Double! Spiral Knuuuckle!!
Go! Double Spiral Knuckle!!
Say it, Kota./　Burnau Far Drag...!
Burnau Far Drag!
Fire Dragon!!/　Goooooo!!
Kota, summon the dragon of flame.
Fire Dragon!/　Buuuuurn!!
Kota, call the Fire Dragon!
Right! Burnau Far Drag!!
Take this! Fire Dragon!!
Kaiser Scanner!
Lock on!
Kota, the Kaiser Sword!
Hyperdimensional aperture, open!
Give us power!
And the all-severing blade!
Burn bright, our souls!
Haaaaaaah!!
Raaaaaagh!!
Over! Kaiser Swooooord!!
Raaaaaah!!
Kaiser Scanner, on!
There you are!
Catch it right, big brother!
Over Gate Engine,/　Max Drive!
This one'll finish it!
G-Thundergate, full boost!!
Burn now! Over Kaiser Swooord!!
Kaiser Craaaash!!
Hell no!/　Think you can beat the G Compati Kaiser?!
Take my name to your grave!
